blocks.zh: 塞子適用性（下）
blocks.en: Plunger Stopper Suitability (Part B)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 說明 hold-up volume（殘留體積）的幾何成因，以及錐形塞子頂端設計如何最小化死體積，進而影響給藥準確性（Section 11.5）
blocks.en: Explain the geometric causes of hold-up volume and how a conical stopper tip design minimizes dead volume, and therefore affects dose accuracy (Section 11.5)

blocks.zh: 識別關鍵塞子尺寸的確定方法（QFD、QbD、堆疊公差分析），理解尺寸失控對 C/C 系統層面屬性的影響（Section 11.6.1）
blocks.en: Identify how critical stopper dimensions are determined (QFD, QbD, stacked tolerance analysis) and understand how loss of dimensional control affects C/C system-level attributes (Section 11.6.1)

blocks.zh: 說明元件製造商在製程中應提供的尺寸控制能力證明，包括模具磨耗監控計畫（Section 11.6.2）
blocks.en: Describe the evidence of dimensional control capability that the component manufacturer should provide for its process, including a mold wear monitoring program (Section 11.6.2)

blocks.zh: 區分 AQL 取樣計畫與製程能力指標（Cpk）的應用場景，識別常用標準（ANSI/ASQ Z1.4、ISO 2859-1、ISO 3951-1）（Section 11.6.3）
blocks.en: Distinguish the use cases for AQL sampling plans and process capability indices (Cpk), and identify the commonly used standards (ANSI/ASQ Z1.4, ISO 2859-1, ISO 3951-1) (Section 11.6.3)

blocks.zh: 解釋為何彈性體量測應優先採用非接觸式量測工具（CMM + 視覺系統），以及接觸式量測的限制（Section 11.6.4）
blocks.en: Explain why noncontact measurement tools (CMM + vision systems) should be preferred for elastomer measurement, and the limitations of contact measurement (Section 11.6.4)

blocks.zh: 描述藥品與塞子之間的交互作用類型（吸附、吸收、可萃取物降解、變色、pH 偏移），連結 Section 14.3.2 的相容性評估框架（Section 11.7）
blocks.en: Describe the types of interaction between drug product and stopper (adsorption, absorption, extractables-induced degradation, discoloration, pH shift) and link them to the compatibility assessment framework in Section 14.3.2 (Section 11.7)

blocks.zh: 識別五種預滅菌二次包裝格式，說明包裝確效標準（ISO 11607-1、ASTM D4169、ASTM F1980）（Section 11.8）
blocks.en: Identify the five presterilized secondary packaging formats and describe the packaging validation standards (ISO 11607-1, ASTM D4169, ASTM F1980) (Section 11.8)

blocks.zh: 解釋影響塞子貨架壽命的主要因素（溫度、濕度、光照、滅菌方式），區分 shelf life 與 useful life 的概念差異（Section 11.9）
blocks.en: Explain the main factors affecting stopper shelf life (temperature, humidity, light, sterilization method) and distinguish the concepts of shelf life and useful life (Section 11.9)

blocks.zh: 11.0 Plunger Stopper Suitability 塞子適用性 (Part B)
blocks.en: 11.0 Plunger Stopper Suitability (Part B)

blocks.zh: 11.5 Hold-up Volume 殘留體積（死體積）
blocks.en: 11.5 Hold-up Volume (Dead Volume)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 Hold-up Volume 的物理意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Physical Meaning of Hold-up Volume

blocks.zh: Hold-up volume（殘留體積 / 死體積）是指推桿完全推至底部後，注射器肩部區域仍無法排出的藥液體積。主要由兩項因素決定：
blocks.en: Hold-up volume (residual volume / dead volume) is the volume of drug solution that cannot be expelled from the shoulder region of the syringe once the plunger has been pushed all the way down. It is determined mainly by two factors:

blocks.zh: 桶肩幾何形狀（主因）：桶身錐形過渡區域的曲率直接決定了最小可達體積。
blocks.en: Barrel shoulder geometry (primary factor): the curvature of the tapered transition region of the barrel directly determines the minimum achievable volume.

blocks.zh: 塞子頂端形狀（次因，但可設計優化）：平頂塞子（flat top）與桶肩間存在死角；輕錐形（light taper/cone）設計能「填入」死角，最小化殘留。
blocks.en: Stopper tip shape (secondary factor, but can be optimized by design): a flat-top stopper leaves a dead corner against the barrel shoulder; a light taper/cone design "fills" that corner and minimizes the residual volume.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Hold-up Volume ×填充重量誤差的關聯
blocks.en: Analogy: Hold-up Volume and Its Link to Fill Weight Error

blocks.zh: 對 Taiwan CDMO fill-finish 而言，hold-up volume 的臨床意義直接體現在給藥準確性：若目標劑量為 1 mL，而死體積為 0.05 mL，患者實際接受劑量只有 0.95 mL——這在生物藥高效能劑型中可能具臨床意義。
blocks.en: For a Taiwan CDMO doing fill-finish, the clinical significance of hold-up volume shows up directly in dose accuracy: if the target dose is 1 mL and the dead volume is 0.05 mL, the patient actually receives only 0.95 mL. For a high-potency biologic dosage form this may be clinically meaningful.

blocks.zh: 把它想成量杯底部的凹槽：即使量到 1 mL 刻度倒出，凹槽裡仍剩一點。選擇「凹槽最淺的量杯」（=錐形塞子頂端）就是最簡單的工程解法。
blocks.en: Think of the groove at the bottom of a measuring cup: even if you pour out to the 1 mL mark, a little liquid stays in the groove. Choosing the cup with the shallowest groove (= a conical stopper tip) is the simplest engineering fix.

blocks.zh: CDMO 操作注意：Fill weight variation（灌裝重量變異）的 CPK 計算時，如果使用不同塞子設計，hold-up volume 差異可能造成系統性偏移——應納入填充工藝驗證（PQ）的評估矩陣。
blocks.en: CDMO practice note: when calculating the Cpk of fill weight variation, differences in hold-up volume between stopper designs can cause a systematic shift. This should be included in the evaluation matrix for fill process validation (PQ).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 設計選擇的時機
blocks.en: Key Point: When to Make the Design Choice

blocks.zh: Hold-up volume 優化屬於容器密封系統（C/C system）設計階段的決定，一旦確認進入穩定性試驗後變更難度極高。建議在 Phase I 臨床用藥設計階段即與塞子供應商討論，而非在 PQ 或商業申報後才發現問題。
blocks.en: Hold-up volume optimization is a decision made at the container closure system (C/C system) design stage; once the design has entered stability studies, changing it is extremely difficult. Discuss it with the stopper supplier during Phase I clinical presentation design, rather than discovering the problem at PQ or after commercial filing.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若客戶反映自動注射器（autoinjector）末次給藥量不足，你會優先懷疑 hold-up volume 問題還是 break-loose force 問題？如何區分？
blocks.en: If a customer reports that the last dose from an autoinjector is under-delivered, would you first suspect a hold-up volume problem or a break-loose force problem? How would you tell them apart?

blocks.zh: 錐形塞子頂端設計對 break-loose force 測試有無影響？方向為何？
blocks.en: Does a conical stopper tip design affect break-loose force testing? In which direction?

blocks.zh: 11.6 Dimensional Control 尺寸控制
blocks.en: 11.6 Dimensional Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念 三大尺寸識別方法論
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Methodologies for Identifying Critical Dimensions

blocks.zh: TR73 提出三種確定關鍵尺寸的方法，各有側重：
blocks.en: TR73 presents three methods for determining critical dimensions, each with a different emphasis:

blocks.zh: QFD（品質機能展開）：從「客戶需求」出發，層層展開到產品/製程特性——確保關鍵尺寸的選擇有臨床與用戶需求依據，而非僅靠工程直覺。
blocks.en: QFD (Quality Function Deployment): starts from "customer needs" and cascades down to product/process characteristics, ensuring that the choice of critical dimensions is based on clinical and user needs rather than engineering intuition alone.

blocks.zh: QbD（品質源於設計）：對應 ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 框架，藉由設計空間（design space）的建立，識別哪些尺寸的變異會影響 CQA。
blocks.en: QbD (Quality by Design): aligned with the ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 framework; by establishing a design space, it identifies which dimensional variations affect CQAs.

blocks.zh: Stacked Tolerance Analysis（堆疊公差分析）：系統層面的幾何公差累積分析——個別元件各自在規格內，但組合後是否仍符合系統功能要求（如 interference fit、break-loose force）。
blocks.en: Stacked Tolerance Analysis: analysis of the accumulation of geometric tolerances at system level. Each component may be within specification individually, but does the assembly still meet system functional requirements (such as interference fit and break-loose force)?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 模具磨耗監控計畫的法規意義
blocks.en: Key Point: Regulatory Significance of the Mold Wear Monitoring Program

blocks.zh: 塞子是射出成型（injection molding）製品，模具磨耗隨生產批次累積而造成系統性尺寸偏移——這是「製程緩慢漂移（process drift）」的典型案例。
blocks.en: Stoppers are injection-molded products, and mold wear accumulates over production batches and causes a systematic dimensional shift. This is a classic example of slow process drift.

blocks.zh: TR73 要求供應商提供模具磨耗監控數據，對 CDMO 的實際意義：
blocks.en: TR73 expects the supplier to provide mold wear monitoring data. In practical terms for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 供應商審計（supplier audit）應要求查閱模具維護記錄與 SPC 圖表。
blocks.en: A supplier audit should request review of mold maintenance records and SPC charts.

blocks.zh: 長期合約應包含「模具更換通知條款」——任何模具更換可能觸發 CDMO 端的年度產品品質回顧（APR/PQR）重新評估。
blocks.en: Long-term contracts should include a "mold change notification clause", because any mold change may trigger a reassessment in the CDMO's annual product quality review (APR/PQR).

blocks.zh: GMP 文件中應記錄「元件供應商製程能力確認」，引用供應商 Cpk 數據作為持續資格確認的依據。
blocks.en: GMP documentation should record the "component supplier process capability confirmation", citing the supplier's Cpk data as the basis for ongoing qualification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 AQL vs. Cpk — 兩種品質語言
blocks.en: Analogy: AQL vs. Cpk, Two Quality Languages

blocks.zh: AQL（Acceptable Quality Level）是「批次抽樣驗收」語言：以 ISO 2859-1 為基礎，關注「這一批能不能放行」。AQL 0.65 表示每百件允許不到 0.65 件缺陷。
blocks.en: AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) is the language of "lot sampling acceptance": based on ISO 2859-1, it asks "can this lot be released?" An AQL of 0.65 means fewer than 0.65 defects per hundred units are tolerated.

blocks.zh: Cpk（製程能力指標）是「製程穩定度」語言：關注「這家工廠的製程是否具備持續生產合格品的能力」。Cpk >1.33 通常為藥用元件的基本要求。
blocks.en: Cpk (process capability index) is the language of "process stability": it asks "is this factory's process capable of consistently producing conforming product?" A Cpk >1.33 is generally the baseline requirement for pharmaceutical components.

blocks.zh: 兩者互補而非替代：AQL 用於入廠逐批決策；Cpk 用於年度供應商評估與持續資格確認（ongoing qualification）。CDMO 的品質協議（Quality Agreement）應明確兩者的標準與責任歸屬。
blocks.en: The two are complementary, not substitutes: AQL is used for lot-by-lot incoming decisions; Cpk is used for annual supplier evaluation and ongoing qualification. The CDMO's Quality Agreement should state the criteria and responsibilities for both clearly.

blocks.zh: 非接觸式量測 vs. 接觸式量測
blocks.en: Noncontact vs. Contact Measurement

blocks.zh: 彈性體（elastomer）的「非剛性（nonrigid）」特性使傳統接觸式量測（卡尺、千分尺）面臨根本挑戰：量測力本身會壓縮被測物，造成讀數偏低——「量具影響了被量的東西」。
blocks.en: The "nonrigid" nature of elastomers poses a fundamental challenge to traditional contact measurement (calipers, micrometers): the measuring force itself compresses the object and gives readings that are too low. The gauge affects the thing being measured.

blocks.zh: 推薦方案——CMM + 視覺系統（noncontact）：
blocks.en: Recommended approach: CMM + vision system (noncontact):

blocks.zh: 雷射掃描或影像量測：不接觸表面，保留原始幾何形狀。
blocks.en: Laser scanning or image-based measurement: no contact with the surface, so the original geometry is preserved.

blocks.zh: 量測系統本身需通過 Gauge R&R（量具重複性與再現性）驗證。
blocks.en: The measurement system itself must pass Gauge R&R (gauge repeatability and reproducibility) validation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 入廠檢驗的實務考量：如果入廠設備僅有卡尺，應在 SOP 中明確記載「施力限制」與「操作員訓練要求」，並在供應商審計時確認供應商的量測方法是否與 CDMO 規格量測條件一致（量測方法協調 harmonization）。
blocks.en: Practical considerations for CDMO incoming inspection: if incoming inspection has only calipers, the SOP should state the "force limit" and "operator training requirements" explicitly, and the supplier audit should confirm whether the supplier's measurement method is consistent with the CDMO's specification measurement conditions (measurement method harmonization).

blocks.zh: 供應商提供的 Cpk = 1.20 for 密封肋直徑，你認為這是否足夠？CDMO 應如何回應（接受 / 要求改善 / 附條件接受）？
blocks.en: A supplier reports a Cpk = 1.20 for sealing rib diameter. Do you consider this sufficient? How should the CDMO respond (accept / require improvement / conditional acceptance)?

blocks.zh: Stacked tolerance analysis 在 PFS 系統中的典型應用場景是什麼？舉出一個具體例子說明如何影響 interference fit。
blocks.en: What is a typical application of stacked tolerance analysis in a PFS system? Give a specific example of how it affects interference fit.

blocks.zh: 若供應商更換了一副射出模具但未通知 CDMO，可能在哪些批次品質指標上最先出現訊號？
blocks.en: If a supplier replaces an injection mold without notifying the CDMO, in which batch quality indicators would the first signals most likely appear?

blocks.zh: 11.7 Product Interactions 藥品與塞子的交互作用
blocks.en: 11.7 Product Interactions: Drug Product and Stopper

blocks.zh: 核心概念 四大交互作用類型
blocks.en: Core Concept: Four Types of Interaction

blocks.zh: TR73 列舉的交互作用可歸納為四類，各有不同的偵測方法：
blocks.en: The interactions listed in TR73 can be grouped into four types, each with different detection methods:

blocks.zh: 吸附（Adsorption）：藥品分子附著於塞子表面（可逆）→ 表現為藥品濃度下降，尤其對蛋白質生物藥。偵測：蛋白質含量定量（SEC-HPLC、BCA）。
blocks.en: Adsorption: drug molecules attach to the stopper surface (reversible) → shows up as a decrease in drug concentration, especially for protein biologics. Detection: protein content quantitation (SEC-HPLC, BCA).

blocks.zh: 吸收（Absorption）：藥品分子進入彈性體基質內部（不可逆）→ 表現為濃度持續下降，難以逆轉。偵測：接觸前後濃度差異。
blocks.en: Absorption: drug molecules enter the elastomer matrix (irreversible) → shows up as a continuing decrease in concentration that is difficult to reverse. Detection: concentration difference before and after contact.

blocks.zh: 可萃取物誘發降解（Leachable-induced degradation）：塞子中的化學物質遷移入藥品後觸發降解 → 表現為雜質峰增加、活性降低。偵測：E&L 研究（ICH Q3E 框架）。
blocks.en: Leachable-induced degradation: chemicals from the stopper migrate into the drug product and trigger degradation → shows up as increased impurity peaks and reduced activity. Detection: E&L studies (ICH Q3E framework).

blocks.zh: 外觀/物理變化：藥品或塞子變色、pH 偏移 → 通常最易被目視發現，但成因仍需確認。
blocks.en: Appearance/physical changes: discoloration of the drug product or stopper, pH shift → usually the easiest to spot visually, but the cause still has to be confirmed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 法規依據與 CDMO 責任
blocks.en: Key Point: Regulatory Basis and CDMO Responsibilities

blocks.zh: FDA 要求 C/C 系統不得對劑型品質造成不可接受的影響（引用 FDA C/C Guidance, 1999），塞子材料至少需符合藥典標準（USP <381> 彈性封閉件、USP <661> 塑膠包裝材料）。
blocks.en: FDA requires that the C/C system must not have an unacceptable effect on the quality of the dosage form (citing the FDA C/C Guidance, 1999); stopper materials must at least meet pharmacopeial standards (USP <381> Elastomeric Closures, USP <661> Plastic Packaging Systems).

blocks.zh: 對 Taiwan CDMO 的意義：
blocks.en: What this means for a Taiwan CDMO:

blocks.zh: 相容性評估（compatibility study）應在 Phase II 結束前完成，並納入 CMC 申報（TFDA 藥品查驗登記）的包裝材料章節。
blocks.en: The compatibility study should be completed before the end of Phase II and included in the packaging materials section of the CMC filing (TFDA drug registration).

blocks.zh: Section 14.3.2 所述的相容性評估結果，是 CDMO 與客戶在技術合約中必須明確責任歸屬的範疇——CDMO 執行測試或由客戶自行評估？
blocks.en: The compatibility assessment results described in Section 14.3.2 fall within the scope where the CDMO and the customer must define responsibilities clearly in the technical agreement: does the CDMO perform the testing, or does the customer evaluate it themselves?

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 可萃取物 vs. 瀝出物的區別
blocks.en: Analogy: The Difference Between Extractables and Leachables

blocks.zh: Extractables（可萃取物）：用嚴苛溶劑（強酸/強鹼/高溫有機溶劑）主動「逼出」的全部潛在物質——是風險評估的「上限值」。
blocks.en: Extractables: all potential substances actively "forced out" using aggressive solvents (strong acid/base, high-temperature organic solvents). This is the "upper bound" for risk assessment.

blocks.zh: Leachables（瀝出物）：在實際藥品接觸條件下（正常 pH、溫度、時間）真正遷移入藥品的物質——是安全評估的「實際暴露值」。
blocks.en: Leachables: substances that actually migrate into the drug product under real product contact conditions (normal pH, temperature, time). This is the "actual exposure" for safety assessment.

blocks.zh: TR73 Section 5.0 詳述 E&L 研究框架。對 CDMO 而言：相容性研究應使用實際配方和實際接觸條件（溫度、pH、儲存時間），不能以水或緩衝液替代。
blocks.en: TR73 Section 5.0 describes the E&L study framework in detail. For a CDMO: compatibility studies should use the actual formulation and actual contact conditions (temperature, pH, storage time); water or buffer cannot be substituted.

blocks.zh: 客戶的 mAb 生物藥在 6 個月穩定性試驗後出現新的未知降解峰，你如何區分是「藥品自身降解」還是「可萃取物誘發降解」？設計調查方案。
blocks.en: A customer's mAb biologic shows new unknown degradation peaks after a 6-month stability study. How would you distinguish "degradation of the drug product itself" from "extractables-induced degradation"? Design an investigation plan.

blocks.zh: 若塞子在接觸特定緩衝液後出現變色，這屬於「藥品品質不可接受」還是「外觀問題」？判定標準是什麼？
blocks.en: If a stopper discolors after contact with a particular buffer, is this an "unacceptable drug product quality" issue or an "appearance" issue? What are the criteria?

blocks.zh: Section 14.3.2 的相容性評估結果如何回饋到塞子選型決策？請描述決策流程。
blocks.en: How do the compatibility assessment results in Section 14.3.2 feed back into the stopper selection decision? Describe the decision flow.

blocks.zh: 11.8 Secondary Packaging 二次包裝
blocks.en: 11.8 Secondary Packaging

blocks.zh: 核心概念 五種預滅菌包裝格式比較
blocks.en: Core Concept: Comparison of Five Presterilized Packaging Formats

blocks.zh: TR73 列舉的包裝格式，選擇依據主要取決於灌裝技術硬體（fill-finish equipment）的需求：
blocks.en: For the packaging formats listed in TR73, the choice depends mainly on the needs of the fill-finish equipment:

blocks.zh: 10×10 Nest（巢式）：定向排列，適合自動化放置設備；減少人員操作接觸。
blocks.en: 10×10 Nest: oriented arrangement, suited to automated placement equipment; reduces operator handling and contact.

blocks.zh: Bulk 密封袋（無 RTP）：成本低，適合傳統無菌轉移區（aseptic transfer corridor）。
blocks.en: Bulk sealed bag (without RTP): low cost, suited to a conventional aseptic transfer corridor.

blocks.zh: Bulk 密封袋 + RTP（快速轉移埠）：適合隔離器（isolator）或 RABS 系統——透過 alpha/beta RTP 介面完成無菌轉移，無需開放環境操作。
blocks.en: Bulk sealed bag + RTP (rapid transfer port): suited to isolator or RABS systems; aseptic transfer is completed through the alpha/beta RTP interface without open-environment handling.

blocks.zh: Tyvek 袋（蒸汽滅菌）：Tyvek 具透氣性，允許蒸汽穿透；輻射滅菌袋則使用多層聚合薄膜。
blocks.en: Tyvek bag (steam sterilization): Tyvek is breathable and allows steam to penetrate; bags for radiation sterilization use multilayer polymer film instead.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 三層包裝的無塵室脫層邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: The Cleanroom De-layering Logic of Three-Layer Packaging

blocks.zh: TR73 明確說明至少三層密封的設計邏輯：
blocks.en: TR73 explicitly describes the design logic of at least three sealed layers:

blocks.zh: 第一層（Primary layer）：直接接觸塞子——滅菌屏障。
blocks.en: First layer (Primary layer): in direct contact with the stopper; the sterile barrier.

blocks.zh: 第二層（Secondary layer）：防止第一層在倉儲/運輸中受污染。
blocks.en: Second layer (Secondary layer): protects the first layer from contamination during storage/transport.

blocks.zh: 第三層（Tertiary layer）：允許在無塵室外走廊擦拭消毒，進入更衣室時脫去第三層；進一步進入無菌區前脫去第二層。
blocks.en: Third layer (Tertiary layer): allows wipe-down disinfection in the corridor outside the cleanroom; the third layer is removed on entering the gowning room, and the second layer is removed before going further into the aseptic area.

blocks.zh: 這種「去污脫層（decontamination shedding）」操作必須有 SOP 支撐，並在無菌模擬填充（APS/Media Fill）中驗證其不引入污染。PIC/S Annex 1 2022 Section 8.6 要求此操作有書面控制程序。
blocks.en: This "decontamination shedding" operation must be supported by an SOP, and it must be shown in the aseptic process simulation (APS/media fill) that it does not introduce contamination. PIC/S Annex 1 (2022), Section 8.6 requires a written control procedure for this operation.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 包裝確效標準的涵義
blocks.en: Analogy: What the Packaging Validation Standards Mean

blocks.zh: 三個確效標準各自覆蓋不同風險維度：
blocks.en: The three validation standards each cover a different risk dimension:

blocks.zh: ISO 11607-1：無菌屏障系統的設計、材料、成型與密封評估——回答「包裝設計是否適合」。
blocks.en: ISO 11607-1: evaluation of the design, materials, forming and sealing of the sterile barrier system; it answers "is the packaging design suitable?"

blocks.zh: ASTM D4169：運輸模擬試驗（振動、衝擊、壓力變化）——回答「運輸過程包裝是否完整」。
blocks.en: ASTM D4169: transport simulation testing (vibration, shock, pressure change); it answers "does the packaging stay intact during transport?"

blocks.zh: ASTM F1980：加速老化試驗——回答「在宣稱的有效期限內包裝是否保持完整」（對應 ICH Q1A 穩定性試驗中的加速條件概念）。
blocks.en: ASTM F1980: accelerated aging testing; it answers "does the packaging remain intact throughout the claimed shelf life?" (comparable to the accelerated conditions concept in ICH Q1A stability testing).

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言：這三個確效通常由供應商負責完成；CDMO 的責任是在供應商審計中確認這些確效報告的存在與有效性，並在 QAgreement 中明定文件提供義務。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: these three validations are usually completed by the supplier. The CDMO's responsibility is to confirm during the supplier audit that these validation reports exist and are valid, and to define the obligation to provide the documents in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: CDMO 計畫新增隔離器（isolator）灌裝線，原使用的 bulk 密封袋塞子包裝需要更換為何種格式？換包裝格式是否需要重新進行相容性評估？
blocks.en: A CDMO plans to add an isolator filling line. What format must the bulk sealed-bag stopper packaging currently in use be changed to? Does changing the packaging format require a new compatibility assessment?

blocks.zh: 供應商提供的塞子包裝不帶 ASTM F1980 老化數據，CDMO 應如何處理？是拒絕使用、要求補充，還是自行執行？
blocks.en: The supplier's stopper packaging comes without ASTM F1980 aging data. How should the CDMO handle this: reject use, request supplementary data, or perform the testing itself?

blocks.zh: 去污脫層操作（decontamination shedding）若未包含在 Media Fill 方案中，對 GMP 合規性有何影響？
blocks.en: If decontamination shedding is not included in the media fill program, what is the impact on GMP compliance?

blocks.zh: 11.9 Shelf Life and Storage 貨架壽命與儲存
blocks.en: 11.9 Shelf Life and Storage

blocks.zh: 核心概念 Shelf Life vs. Useful Life 的概念區分
blocks.en: Core Concept: Distinguishing Shelf Life from Useful Life

blocks.zh: TR73 刻意區分兩個易混淆的概念：
blocks.en: TR73 deliberately distinguishes two easily confused concepts:

blocks.zh: Shelf Life（元件貨架壽命）：塞子從製造日到「必須使用前」的總時間——由元件製造商依材料特性、包裝形式、儲存條件指定。這是塞子「作為元件本身」的期限。
blocks.en: Shelf Life (component shelf life): the total time from the stopper's manufacture date to its "use-by" date, specified by the component manufacturer based on material characteristics, packaging form and storage conditions. This is the limit for the stopper "as a component in its own right".

blocks.zh: Useful Life（有效使用期限）：塞子在與藥品接觸後能持續執行功能的總期限——由藥品製造商（CDMO/客戶）透過加速或實時穩定性試驗確定。這是塞子「作為灌裝藥品一部分」的期限。
blocks.en: Useful Life: the total period over which the stopper can continue to perform its function after contact with the drug product, determined by the drug product manufacturer (CDMO/customer) through accelerated or real-time stability studies. This is the limit for the stopper "as part of the filled drug product".

blocks.zh: Useful Life ≤ Shelf Life，但影響因素不同。Shelf life 到期的塞子不能使用；Shelf life 尚未到期但 useful life 研究顯示功能降解的塞子同樣不合格。
blocks.en: Useful Life ≤ Shelf Life, but the influencing factors differ. A stopper past its shelf life cannot be used; a stopper still within shelf life but whose useful life study shows functional degradation is likewise unacceptable.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Useful Life × ICH Q1A 穩定性試驗框架
blocks.en: Analogy: Useful Life and the ICH Q1A Stability Testing Framework

blocks.zh: Useful life 的確定邏輯直接對應 ICH Q1A(R2) 穩定性試驗框架：
blocks.en: The logic for determining useful life corresponds directly to the ICH Q1A(R2) stability testing framework:

blocks.zh: 加速穩定性試驗（Accelerated Stability Studies）：通常 40°C/75% RH 或依 ICH 分區要求，用於早期預測和支持臨時有效期。
blocks.en: Accelerated Stability Studies: typically 40°C/75% RH or as required by the ICH climatic zone, used for early prediction and to support a provisional expiry period.

blocks.zh: 實時穩定性試驗（Real-time Stability Studies）：在建議儲存條件下進行，為最終有效期的確認依據。
blocks.en: Real-time Stability Studies: conducted under the recommended storage conditions, and the basis for confirming the final expiry period.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的意義：穩定性試驗方案（stability protocol）中必須包含「塞子功能性測試項目」（break-loose force、CCI、外觀）——這些不是僅測藥品的試驗，而是整個 PFS 系統的試驗。忽略塞子功能測試的穩定性方案在 TFDA / FDA 查廠時可能受到質疑。
blocks.en: What this means for a CDMO: the stability protocol must include "stopper functionality tests" (break-loose force, CCI, appearance). These are not tests of the drug product alone but of the whole PFS system. A stability protocol that ignores stopper functionality testing may be challenged during TFDA / FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 影響 Shelf Life 的四大因素
blocks.en: Key Point: Four Main Factors Affecting Shelf Life

blocks.zh: TR73 明確列舉影響塞子貨架壽命的主要因素，以及 CDMO 的控制策略：
blocks.en: TR73 explicitly lists the main factors affecting stopper shelf life, along with the CDMO's control strategy:

blocks.zh: 溫度（最關鍵）：低溫儲存 → 長 shelf life。CDMO 應在元件儲存區建立溫度監控（含偏差記錄），確保符合供應商規定的儲存條件。
blocks.en: Temperature (most critical): lower storage temperature gives a longer shelf life. The CDMO should establish temperature monitoring (including deviation records) in the component storage area to ensure compliance with the storage conditions specified by the supplier.

blocks.zh: 濕度：高濕度加速老化。密封包裝是主要屏障；包裝完整性要定期確認。
blocks.en: Humidity: high humidity accelerates aging. Sealed packaging is the main barrier; packaging integrity should be confirmed periodically.

blocks.zh: 光照：紫外線加速橡膠老化。儲存區域應避光。
blocks.en: Light: ultraviolet light accelerates rubber aging. Storage areas should be protected from light.

blocks.zh: 加工（滅菌）：已滅菌塞子 shelf life 通常短於未滅菌散裝塞子。輻射滅菌 vs. 蒸汽滅菌對 shelf life 的影響方向不同，應向供應商確認具體數據。
blocks.en: Processing (sterilization): the shelf life of sterilized stoppers is usually shorter than that of non-sterilized bulk stoppers. Radiation and steam sterilization affect shelf life in different ways; confirm the specific data with the supplier.

blocks.zh: CDMO 倉庫溫度記錄顯示某批塞子曾短暫暴露於超規格溫度（+5°C 過 8 小時），如何評估此偏差對 shelf life 的影響？需要引用什麼數據？
blocks.en: The CDMO warehouse temperature record shows that a lot of stoppers was briefly exposed to an out-of-specification temperature (+5°C for 8 hours). How do you assess the impact of this deviation on shelf life? What data would you cite?

blocks.zh: 客戶要求 PFS 產品有效期 24 個月，但塞子供應商僅提供 18 個月的 shelf life 數據。CDMO 應如何處理這個落差？
blocks.en: A customer requires a 24-month expiry for the PFS product, but the stopper supplier provides shelf life data for only 18 months. How should the CDMO handle this gap?

blocks.zh: 加速穩定性試驗中，塞子 break-loose force 在 40°C/75%RH × 6 個月後出現上升趨勢。這代表什麼？對 useful life 確認有何影響？
blocks.en: In an accelerated stability study, stopper break-loose force shows an upward trend after 6 months at 40°C/75%RH. What does this mean? What is the impact on confirming useful life?
